To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
lamotrigine is superior to lithium for the prevention of depressive relapses in patients with bipolar disorder.
lamotrigine is more effi cient than lithium in the prevention of bipolar depression.

lamotrigine is more effi cacious than lithium in the maintenance treatment of bipolar disorder, but the effi cacy of lamotriginetreatment is lower than that reported in previous studies, and that the effi cacies of lamotriginetherapy and lithium monotherapy in the maintenance treatment for bipolar disorder are comparable.

the study of the mechanisms by which the brain controls behaviour.

lamotrigine is a good alternative to lithium for maintenance treatment of bipolar disorder and that it might be better in terms of side-effects and patient compliance, although this conclusion is based on a limited amount of data from a small number of studies, some of which have been conducted in a less than ideal manner.

the virus can adapt to a drug very quickly and that the drug can lose its effectiveness.
